verdict.rationale: The docs say Scrape can return Markdown, HTML, a screenshot, images, or CSS-selected fields in one request, and async batch crawls can return Markdown or HTML. JSON Schema extraction is also available. That covers format selection for two of the four named formats. Missing for 10: evidence of a plain-text output option, frontmatter/metadata output, documentation of the per-request format-selection parameter, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
